boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Nebraska-Lincoln
boards.description: Ten currently listed food destinations with late operating hours in Lincoln, emphasizing downtown and campus-area options with under-21-safe food service.

cards.title: Toppers Pizza
cards.subtitle: 1226 P Street, Lincoln
cards.notes: Use the Lincoln location page to confirm the nightly 3 AM closing time before heading to this P Street pizza shop.
cards.short_summary: A P Street pizza option listed open until 3 AM daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Toppers lists its Lincoln location at 1226 P Street with hours of 10:30 AM–3 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official location listing states 10:30 AM–3 AM daily; confirm before travel.

cards.title: George's Gourmet Grill Downtown
cards.subtitle: 1400 O Street, Lincoln
cards.notes: Order or pick up from the downtown O Street location when its listed 2:45 AM closing time fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: Downtown grill with food-service hours listed through 2:45 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: George's Gourmet Grill Downtown lists its address as 1400 O Street and hours of 10 AM–2:45 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists 10 AM–2:45 AM; check the page for exceptions.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza on P Street
cards.subtitle: 1230 P Street, Lincoln
cards.notes: Check the store page’s day-specific close time, then use its P Street address for carryout or delivery planning.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza store whose official page lists late close times.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's lists its store at 1230 P Street in Lincoln and displays operating hours up to 2 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official store page displays day-specific hours, including closing as late as 2 AM.

cards.title: Tacos Los Hermanos Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: 4401 N 70th Street, Lincoln
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday drive-thru stop; the restaurant’s location page specifically lists service until 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A Lincoln drive-thru with Friday and Saturday service listed until 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Tacos Los Hermanos lists its Lincoln location at 4401 N 70th Street and says its drive-thru is open until 2 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists drive-thru service until 2 AM Friday and Saturday only.

cards.title: El Chaparro
cards.subtitle: 900 S 13th Street, Lincoln
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s posted schedule for a late food pickup, especially on its Friday and Saturday late-hour nights.
cards.short_summary: A 13th Street Mexican restaurant with late listed operating hours.
cards.evidence_claim: El Chaparro lists 900 S 13th Street and posted opening hours through 1 AM Monday–Thursday, 3 AM Friday, and 3:30 AM Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists service through 1 AM weekdays and later Friday–Saturday; verify day-specific hours.

cards.title: Ramos Pizza & Pub
cards.subtitle: 2435 S 48th Street, Lincoln
cards.notes: Consult the posted daily schedule before leaving; it lists food-service hours extending past midnight throughout the week.
cards.short_summary: A pizza restaurant with nightly hours listed past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramos Pizza & Pub lists 2435 S 48th Street and hours until 2 AM Monday–Thursday, 3 AM Friday–Saturday, and 1:30 AM Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists closing times from 1:30–3 AM, depending on day.

cards.title: IHOP on N 27th Street
cards.subtitle: 4501 N 27th Street, Lincoln
cards.notes: Use this north Lincoln IHOP when an all-night dining room is useful; the official location page lists every day as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour IHOP location in north Lincoln.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its restaurant at 4501 N 27th Street in Lincoln as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the restaurant open 24 hours every day.

cards.title: Taco Bell on N 27th Street
cards.subtitle: 3310 N 27th Street, Lincoln
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru listing rather than dine-in hours: the official page posts service through 3 AM every day.
cards.short_summary: A north Lincoln Taco Bell with a 3 AM drive-thru listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 3310 N 27th Street location’s drive-thru hours as 7 AM–3 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru until 3 AM daily; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Cberry's Barbecue
cards.subtitle: 1422 O Street, Lincoln
cards.notes: Reserve this O Street option for Friday or Saturday: the restaurant posts a dedicated 11 PM–3 AM late-night service window.
cards.short_summary: A downtown barbecue restaurant with Friday and Saturday late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: Cberry's lists its address at 1422 O Street and late-night hours of 11 PM–3 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official business page lists 11 PM–3 AM service Friday and Saturday only.

cards.title: Hurts Donut
cards.subtitle: 129 N 10th Street #100, Lincoln
cards.notes: Check the downtown location page for directions; its official location graphic identifies the shop as “Open 25/8.”
cards.short_summary: A downtown doughnut shop whose official location page advertises “Open 25/8.”
cards.evidence_claim: Hurts Donut lists its Lincoln location at 129 N 10th Street #100 and labels it “Open 25/8.”
cards.access_notes: Official Lincoln location page displays “Open 25/8”; confirm availability before travel.
